note: Manufacturing defect feedback; includes a conflicting severity pair.

corrections.author: mfg.eng@example.com
corrections.subject: wrong firmware version
corrections.body: The affected line ran mold-controller firmware 2.0.5, not 2.1.1. Lines on 2.1.1 did not reproduce the defect.

corrections.author: qc_reviewer
corrections.subject: duration + blank actions
corrections.body: The affected run was five hours (06:40 to 11:40), and Corrective Actions is blank.

corrections.author: plant.manager@example.com
corrections.subject: severity too low
corrections.body: A structural hairline crack is Critical, not Cosmetic.

corrections.author: qc_reviewer
corrections.subject: severity assessment
corrections.body: Contained on hold with nothing shipped, so Major per the matrix, not Critical.

corrections.author: qc_reviewer
corrections.subject: wrong figure
corrections.body: The Timeline figure reference is wrong; it should be the cavity pressure trace.
